_note: Single-source (Aztec / Mexica). Nahuatl sub-palette of the Mesoamerican family; a Triple-Alliance theocratic empire of the Hueyi Tlatoani, the calpolli wards, the chinampa and the war-cult, the teocalli pyramid-temple and the calendar-round. civ = feudal. CHAOTIC ALONE - a blood-cult empire of human sacrifice and conquest, feeding the war-sun with offered hearts. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Nahuatl register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the Nahuatl morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_mesoamerican.json theonym_sets.nahuatl), never real Aztec gods.

phonology.palette: Nahuatl: absolutive -tl/-tli and reverential -tzin; tl, tz, ch, x (sh), hu/uh (w), ku; place-suffixes -tlan/-titlan/-tepec/-co; CV(C).
phonology.phonotactics: CV(C); the -tl cluster; vowel-final absolutives; no voiced stops.

morphology.patronymic_form: the calpolli (ward) name; calendar-day names (the tonalli day); a deed/war-name earned in battle; nobles (pipiltin) trace the tecuhtli (lord) line.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Triple-Alliance theocratic empire: the Hueyi Tlatoani over the tlatoque city-kings and the pipiltin nobility; the calpolli wards and the war-cult below)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Aztec civ, ascending. Built on tlatoani (speaker/ruler): Tlatoani (city-king of an altepetl) duchy; Hueyi Tlatoani (great speaker, emperor) kingdom; Cem-Anahuac Tlatoani (ruler of all the world) empire. Tecuhtli (lord) barony; Tlacatecuhtli (war-chief) march; Tecpantlatoani (governor) county; Tlatocatecuhtli (over-king) principality. The pipiltin nobility, the calpolli wards and the war-cult sustain the realm. (Rank titles are the real Nahuatl register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: calendar-day name (tonalli) + a deed/war-name; the calpolli (ward) or, for nobles (pipiltin), the tecuhtli lineage; -tzin reverential for the honored.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the pipiltin (nobles) carry a lineage and lordly -tzin titles; the macehualtin (commoners) a day-name + ward.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names invoke the powers (Nahuan's names) + an element: -tzin (revered), Teo- (divine): e.g. Tolra-tzin, Teo-Marakatl; calendar-and-power day-names.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Nahuatl morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_mesoamerican.json theonym_sets.nahuatl) - never real Aztec gods (no Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca, Huitzilopochtli, Tlaloc, Xipe Totec). Shared pantheon, Nahuan names. Nahuan is Chaotic alone: a blood-cult empire that venerates the Chaotic powers - chief among them Marakatl, the War-Fire / the Blood-Sun that must be fed by sacrifice - and DEMONIZES the One (Aiternatl) and the Lawful powers as the cold tyrants of the soft. The calendar-round and the offered heart bind the people to the powers; the teocalli (pyramid-temple) and the skull-rack are the altars.
religion.the_one: Aiternatl (< Aeternus; the One, REVILED as the Tyrant-Sun - the cold sky that would starve the world of blood; cursed, never revered)

sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Marakatl (the War-Fire, the Blood-Sun that must be fed; chief of the venerated powers)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the One and the Lawful powers are the enemy-gods, named with dread: Aeternus -> Aiternatl the Tyrant-Sun (the chief enemy); Tulrius -> Tolratl the Cold-Sun; Orlandus -> Orlantzin the Soft-Oath; Numeno -> Numenatl the Idle-Scribe.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Teocalli (god-house) atop the great pyramid of [power]: 'the Teocalli of Marakatl', crowned by the skull-rack.
religion.saints_pattern: fallen warriors and offered captives become sun-feeding companions and hummingbird-spirits; the conqueror-tlatoque honored at the teocalli and the skull-rack.

holy_symbol_motifs.Marakatl: an obsidian knife over a blood-fed sun
holy_symbol_motifs.Wakitl: an open maw swallowing a star
holy_symbol_motifs.Lusankoatl: a coiled serpent over a heap of jade

banks_patterns.ships: lake and canal canoes (acalli): trade-canoe names 'the Jade Canoe', 'the Quetzal of Anahuac'
banks_patterns.military_units: the warrior-societies: the [order] knights: 'the Eagle Knights (Cuauhtli)', 'the Jaguar Knights (Ocelotl)'
banks_patterns.taverns: the octli (pulque) house: 'the [Adjective] [Noun]': 'the Octli House', 'the Flower-Song Court'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: abandoned teocalli and drowned chinampa-cities: 'the Sunken Teocalli of [name]', 'the lost Altepetl of [tlatoani]'
